checks.name: E3-시장 분위기 정확성
checks.detail: Two concrete errors: (1) 'QQQ distribution days hit 8 (DANGER)' is not supported — independent trackers show 0 Nasdaq distribution days as of Aug 16, 2026, with IBD market status 'Confirmed Uptrend,' not a distribution-day warning. (2) 'US equities still hit records on Aug 16' is impossible as stated — Aug 16, 2026 is a Sunday (markets closed); records were more plausibly set the prior week (data as of the Aug 14 Friday close, which is the 'last session' the watchlist itself uses). These two errors undercut the DANGER framing that anchors the whole mood headline.

checks.name: E4-섹터 동향 정확성
checks.detail: questionable: AMZN/MSFT as uptrend leaders and PLTR/VST as downtrend laggards are individually plausible technical reads, but the 'rotation toward energy/infrastructure' narrative isn't corroborated — VST (an energy name) is itself listed as a DOWNTREND laggard, which sits awkwardly next to the claim that money is rotating into energy/infrastructure UPTREND names. Also, separate reporting describes PLTR trading near its record highs off strong Q2 growth, in some tension with the flat 'DOWNTREND despite narrative interest' characterization (different snapshots, so not a hard contradiction, but worth flagging).

grok_report.summary: The single global issue (China tariff-evasion enforcement) is well-sourced and accurate, and spot-checked prices (NVDA $225.16, TSM $426.35, MU $971.66) match real closes. However, the Market Mood section contains two clear factual problems — a distribution-day count that contradicts independent trackers (0, not 8) and a claim of new highs on a date the market was closed (Sunday Aug 16) — which is significant since these anchor the 'DANGER'/green-98.1 headline. Sector rotation commentary is internally slightly inconsistent (VST framed as both a rotation beneficiary sector and a laggard).
